Pick a locker from the Locker room, and include this as instructed.

Questions regarding the locker assigned can be sent to president.oslo@biso.no

BISO Book Locker BU1

Prices:

*BISO members 500 NOK / Year

Non BISO members 1500 NOK / Year

*BISO members 250 NOK / Semester

Non BISO members 750 NOK / Semester

 

You are obligated to obtain a proper lock for the booklocker and ensure its condition is fit for use. BISO is not liable for any personal belongings that are lost or stolen.
The presence of food or other waste will not be tolerated.

The deadline for emptying your locker is 1st of August 2026. Lockers that have not been emptied out by this date, will be cleaned out by the BISO Management. Regardless, BISO is not responsible for the loss of valuables.

excerpt.rendered:
At BISOs national meeting in april, the assembly voted that SAIH is the organization we want to support.

Norwegian Students’ and Academic’s International Assistance Fund

SAIH works for human rights, academic freedom, and that all young people have access to quality education, in order to contribute to a more just society.

SAIH works through long-term development work with 30 partner organizations in seven countries in Latin-America, Southern Africa, and Asia. They work with advocacy in Norway and internationally, to improve the conditions for education and development globally and with the protection of student activists.

Your contribution to SAIH will strengthen their ability to continue the fight for the right to education, academic freedom, and democracy around the world. Read more: https://saih.no/english/
